title: calliandra colletioides subsp. gonavensis
intro: Calliandra colletioides subsp. gonavensis, commonly known as the Gonavea tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and it is known to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra colletioides subsp. gonavensis include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating respiratory infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
